text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hii, Trainer!
It's the start of a wonderful post-holiday, isn't it!
choice_data_list: !? Where on earth is that voice coming from...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fufu, how was that? A perfect landing, wouldn't you say!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Enjoying skydiving during my vacation
left me thoroughly refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Cutting through the wind and soaring through the air
really does feel wonderful! Jumping like this
is just simply GREAT, too!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems Seeking the Pearl thoroughly enjoyed her day off and feels completely refreshed.
